text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's bad health isn't<n>improving. Rumors
spread that I'm to<n>blame for her inability to run.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unhappy with the situation, she<n>resolves to change
public opinion by<n>training more—only to fall ill once
more.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I see this and realize that the cause of<n>her illness is
that she's trying too<n>hard for the sake of others.
